avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces apremilast plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin-containing products
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer significantly decreases apremilast bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; coordinate with prescribing physician for alternative antimicrobial therapy

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inducer may slightly reduce apremilast levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced efficacy; use with caution and physician awareness

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May affect GI absorption; apremilast has variable bioavailability
caution_supplements.action: Space dosing 2 hours apart; monitor clinical response

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Increases apremilast absorption and peak plasma concentrations, potentially increasing adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Take apremilast with consistent meal composition; avoid substantial fat intake at dosing time

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase apremilast levels; clinical significance unclear at approved doses
caution_foods.action: Limit grapefruit consumption; monitor for increased side effects (nausea, headache)

caution_foods.name: Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: Both apremilast and caffeine undergo CYP1A2 metabolism; potential for increased CNS stimulation
caution_foods.action: Moderate caffeine intake; report increased tremor or anxiety to healthcare provider

monitoring_notes: Apremilast is primarily metabolized via CYP3A4 with minor CYP1A2 involvement; monitor for efficacy loss with enzyme inducers and adverse effect escalation with enzyme inhibitors. Gastrointestinal tolerability is common; counsel on meal timing and consistency to optimize absorption and minimize nausea.
